title: Immunological Signatures of MASLD and MASH in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes
official: Immunological Signatures of MASLD and MASH in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes
summary: MASLD and its inflammatory form, MASH, are major public health concerns due to their high prevalence and association with hepatic and cardiovascular morbidity and mortality. Although extensively studied in type 2 diabetes (T2D), their pathophysiology in type 1 diabetes (T1D) remains poorly understood. Given the differences in immune mechanisms between T1D, primarily involving adaptive immunity, and T2D, associated with chronic innate immune activation, MASH may involve distinct immunoinflammatory pathways depending on the type of diabetes. This cross-sectional study aims to identify specific immunological and transcriptomic signatures associated with MASLD/MASH in patients with T1D and compare them with those observed in T2D, ultimately improving understanding of disease mechanisms and hepatic and cardiovascular risk stratification.
